criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Order & Delivery
categories.definition: Queries about ordering new physical or virtual cards, delivery status, tracking, and specific delivery requests.

categories.name: Card Activation & PIN Management
categories.definition: Queries about activating cards, finding, changing, resetting, or unblocking PINs.

categories.name: Card Functionality & Usage
categories.definition: Queries about physical or virtual card not working (declined, contactless issues, ATM issues), general card questions (Mastercard/Visa, where to use).

categories.name: Virtual Card Information
categories.definition: Specific questions about obtaining, limits, location, and general understanding of virtual or disposable cards.

categories.name: Lost, Stolen, or Damaged Card
categories.definition: Queries about what to do when a card is lost, stolen, or damaged, including freezing the card or account due to card compromise.

categories.name: Additional Card Requests
categories.definition: Requests for extra cards for family members or for personal use.

categories.name: Account Access & Security
categories.definition: Issues with logging in, forgotten passwords/passcodes, app access, or identity verification for app access.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close or delete an account.

categories.name: Account Details & Settings
categories.definition: Changing personal details or general account settings.

categories.name: Account Opening & Eligibility
categories.definition: Questions about opening an account, age requirements, or opening accounts for minors.

categories.name: Initiate Funds Transfer or Top-up
categories.definition: How to make a transfer, payment, or top-up; methods, costs, limits, and auto-top-up features.

categories.name: Transaction Status & Issues
categories.definition: Queries about pending, failed, missing, or delayed transactions, incorrect amounts, or transactions not appearing.

categories.name: Transaction Fees & Charges
categories.definition: Questions about unexpected fees, charges for transfers, withdrawals, or payments.

categories.name: Refunds & Transaction Cancellations
categories.definition: Requests to cancel transactions, inquire about refunds, or issues with receiving refunds.

categories.name: Unrecognised or Fraudulent Transactions
categories.definition: Reporting suspicious, unrecognised, or fraudulent transactions, direct debits, or charges.

categories.name: Source of Funds Inquiry
categories.definition: Inquiries about where money in the account came from or validating funds.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about supported currencies, exchange rates, fees for currency exchange, or issues with applied exchange rates.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about the identity verification process, requirements, or issues with verification.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: General inquiries about the banking service not covered by other categories.
